scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WORKER,WEB -c cyan,yellow,green "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter worker dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter worker build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:prod: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/database && npx ts-node --project tsconfig.json prisma/seed.ts
scripts.zapbox:db:migrate: cd packages/zapbox-db && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.zapbox:db:migrate:prod: cd packages/zapbox-db && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.webhook:test: echo "Asaas: configure webhook em app.asaas.com > Configuracoes > Notificacoes"
